items.title: Tractor Supply (TSCO) Stock Slides As Q3 Results Expose Margin Strain
items.summary: Tractor Supply came into this earnings print with the stock quietly grinding higher over the last three months, then gave back ground today as the shares slipped about 4% in midday trading. That move lands right after Q3 2026 results that showed net sales of US$3.91b and diluted earnings per share of roughly US$0.43, with an operating margin near 7.9% that keeps the pressure squarely on profitability. items.title: Tractor Supply's Q3 Beat Plants the Seeds for a Stock Rebound
